parsed.explanation: Thin dossier: no trans-specific offence, targeting, violence or facility/border exposure is documented, and same-sex conduct is legal with marriage expressly covering gender identity - a tolerant institutional signal. However there is no documented social acceptance of trans people, no gender-identity anti-discrimination recourse for a visitor (constitution names sexual orientation only), and no evidence on facilities, documents, custody or care. Absence of incidents in a ~50-resident, thin-record territory is not evidence of safety. Rating extrapolates from the absence of criminalisation and legal tolerance, held below the acceptance-with-working-protections tier by unknown reception and lack of trans-specific remedy.
